what: DVOA blend shadow line (50/50 B$ + DVOA on the 2026-performance part, from Week 5) vs the official B$ line and the close. Shadow only: not in the B$ line, the record, Bet History, Overall Record, ATS or the B$ Daily.

method.shadow: shadow_dvoa_blend.rounded on the last data/model/bs-line-history-2026.json version published before kick (app.js dvoaBlendShadowHomeSpread, weight DVOA_BLEND_SHADOW_WEIGHT).
method.official: Lock model_home_spread rounded to the nearest 0.5 (.25/.75 away from zero), same as data/record/lib.mjs from Week 4. No lock: last pre-kick snapshot b_line, flagged in official_source.
method.close: line-history close tag, else data/closes file, else lock street at freeze, else last pre-kick street snapshot (see close_source).
method.error: Absolute error vs the final home margin; a home spread L implies an expected home margin of -L.
method.ats: data/model/game_day_grade.mjs atsGrade vs the close. Gap buckets use |line - close|: <3, 3-8, 8+.

sandmoney_pr5_backtest.note: 2021-25 replica (results rating only; no PFF/Madden/injury history). Close = nflverse.
sandmoney_pr5_backtest.caveat: Frozen DVOA coefficients were fit on 2021-23; 2024-25 is the only out-of-sample stretch.
